content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Custom Labels ## slug: vt-custom-labels ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Info) (The following picklist values can now be translated using custom labels.) * Action * “New Single Charge” * “New Payment Method” * Process Type * “Capture Now” * “Auto-Process” * “Authorize Now” ::: Custom Labels are custom text values, up to 1,000 characters, that can be accessed from Apex Classes or Visualforce Pages. Our Payments package includes the following Custom Labels for the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}}. * Action * Related To * Parent Object * Payment Method * Amount * Process Type * Currency ![J_02_02_custom_labels](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/J_02_02_custom_labels.png){height="" width=""} Before modifying a Custom Label, please complete the following configuration step in the Translation Workbench. This step is required to be able to modify customizations managed by the Payments package. **Virtual Terminal - Custom Labels with Translation Workbench Setup** ## Update Settings in Translation Workbench 1. Navigate to Setup. 2. In the Quick Find box, type "workbench". 3. Click **Translation Workbench**. 4. Click **Translation Language Settings**. 5. Click **Enable**. 6. Click **Add**. 7. Select your {{variable.Field_TranslWorkbench_Language}}. 8. Check {{variable.Field_TranslWorkbenchActive}}. 9. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ## Update Virtual Terminal Labels in Custom Labels 1. Navigate to Setup. 2. In the Quick Find box, type "Custom Labels". 3. Click **Custom Labels**. 4. Find the Custom Labels with "VT" in the name. 5. Click the hyperlinked name of the Virtual Terminal Label you would like to modify. 6. Click **New Local Translations/ Overrides**. 7. Select your {{variable.Field_Translation_Language}}. 8. Add the text for the label you would like to see displayed in the {{variable.Field_CustomLabel_TranslatText}} field. *Example: Master Label = VT Action > {{variable.Field_CustomLabel_TranslatText}} = "Custom Action". "Custom Action" will be what a user sees on the Virtual Terminal.*
